subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text :
stimulus: "I've got GPA-5 in the SSC Examination," said Abir. "Congratulations, brother!" I said. "What do you intend to do now?" "I wish to study in a reputed college," Abir replied. চ্যান্সেলর এসএসসি শটর্ সাজেশন্সের উত্তরমালা  104
guide_solution: Abir said that he had got GPA-5 in the SSC Examination. Addressing him as brother, I congratulated him and asked what he intended to do then. Abir replied that he wished to study in a reputed college.
